description:
## What to build

render_html accepts the template and css as parameters and does no file I/O of its own; __main__ loads assets/style.css and assets/index.html.tmpl and passes them in. The model->HTML transform becomes a pure, deep module.

Behavior-preserving: generated HTML must be byte-identical before and after.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] render_html takes template and css as parameters and performs no filesystem access
- [ ] __main__ loads style.css and index.html.tmpl and injects them into render_html
- [ ] Renderer tests exercise render_html with a fixed inline template/css, not the real asset files on disk
- [ ] Generated HTML output is unchanged (byte-identical) vs. before
- [ ] Existing test suite green (docs/tests)

## Blocked by

- None — can start immediately.
title: Inject template + css through render_html's interface
